subject: Quick note on R N Thomson's website
bodyText:
Hi,

I'm Mani from Rogue.

We look for solid businesses that still look stuck online - and R N Thomson stood out.

Ayr builders and joiners on West Sanquhar Road - and rnthomson.co.uk still ships as HTML 4.0 Transitional, runs live MARQUEE banners, still publishes Fax: 01292 265400, and literally says Last updated 05/07/00. Fifty-plus years of building and wet trades; a front end frozen like a late-90s brochure page.

If useful, I'll send a short 3-point teardown over email - what's dated, what's costing you, and the first fix. No call required.

Reply YES and I'll send it.
